column1: # Every click handler in src/main/java on a node, and why it needs no keyboard or screen-reader path of its own
# (ACC-02, Pauta 6.0.1). Read by ClickHandlersGuardTest. One line per file, receiver and method, tab-separated:
# A node built from panes or labels that acts as a button is a PressableLabel / PressableBox / PressablePane
# (com.editora.editor.Pressable) and needs no line here. A new handler on anything else needs one: a Control
# (its own role and keys), or the command or key that does the same, or why it is no action (a drag, a raise).
